Careers, Information Advice and Guidance
Welcome to E-ACT Ousedale Careers Information Advice & Guidance
We have a dedicated Careers area on our SharePoint (pupils can access this from the homepage of our website). Please spend some time looking through this to explore careers linked to your favourite subject, post 16 or post 18 options, finding virtual work experience placements, researching Labour Market Information, or grow your knowledge about apprenticeships. There is also a section looking at career stories from past pupils. The Careers area of SharePoint has been created to be a place for you to spend some time exploring your options and finding opportunities for your future.
If you have any questions or need support, please email us: careers@ous.e-act.org.uk
We are committed to giving quality impartial information, advice and guidance to all pupils from Years 7-13 by educating them on future opportunities and potential career paths based on their individual needs. Encouraging pupils to recognise and embrace their own distinct set of characteristics, skills and knowledge. Allowing pupils to make informed career choices based on Labour Market Information, including the different study options available and necessary qualifications required.
Ousedale undertake a varied programme of careers education and incorporate this into the curriculum. All activities are designed to develop pupil’s self-awareness and develop employability skills whilst enhancing their knowledge of different career sectors and roles. We hold a variety of career events which include employer engagement, National event visits, one to one career sessions, group work and assemblies. These are outlined in our Careers Programme (see PDF below).
All pupils will have a one-to-one meeting about their career routes and post 16 options. We openly encourage them to engage with us on a regular basis to obtain the information and support they need.
Appointments can be requested by pupils, staff members or parents/carers, at any time.
Nicola Austen - Careers Manager
Tel: 01908 210203 ext 3267
Our career staff work flexibly across both campuses.
If you feel a career guidance interview would be beneficial and would like to book an appointment, please email careers@ous.e-act.org.uk
If you are a past pupil who is willing to share your career story with our current pupils, please complete the Alumni form and declaration. This will be used as a motivational tool to help inspire and prepare our pupils for the world of work.
If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact Nicola Austen via careers@ous.e-act.org.uk
Ousedale measures and assesses the impact of the careers programme on pupils by gathering feedback from pupils following one-to-one sessions and events. Pupils' outcomes and final destinations are also monitored.
Please see the PDF booklets below for our latest post-16 and post-18 options.
Careerometer: A tool to compare jobs
The Careerometer tool will help you to compare different job roles that you may be interested in. It uses up to date labour market information collected by LMI for All. It will show you data relating to pay, weekly hours of work and future employment prospects for the job role you select.
To use the Careerometer all you need to do is click on one of the cards below. Simply type in the first career that you think you might be interested in and select from the drop down list. This will then give you the pay, hours of work and future employment prospects for that job role. You can then click on the other two cards to add your second and third choices to see the comparison.

About Us
Welcome to E-ACT Ousedale School, we are an award-winning, vibrant 11-19 academy set across two campuses, Newport Pagnell and Olney.
For full details about our school, please visit our pages on the links to the right of this page.

Parents
Welcome to our Parents/Carers Area
We are committed to maintaining close relationships with parents/carers of our pupils at E-ACT Ousedale School to maximise the support we offer our pupils.
Within this section is a host of useful information. If there is any information that you cannot find, please contact school at enquiries@ous.e-act.org.uk and we will do our best to supply it.
